items.title: Abbott Receives FDA Approval for First and Only Device in the U.S. to Treat Leaks After Heart Valve Replacement Without Additional Surgery
items.title_zh: 雅培Amplatzer Paraclose PVL封堵器获FDA批准,成为美国首个无需再次外科手术即可治疗瓣周漏的器械
items.summary_zh: 2026年10月28日,美国FDA批准雅培(Abbott)的Amplatzer Paraclose PVL封堵器上市,使其成为美国首个且唯一获批的经导管瓣周漏(PVL)封堵器械,用于治疗外科主动脉瓣或二尖瓣置换术后出现的瓣周漏,为患者提供无需再次开胸手术的微创替代方案。该器械经股动脉或股静脉穿刺送入,在欧洲已以Amplatzer Valvular Plug III之名销售六年。此次批准基于前瞻性、多中心、单臂的PARADIGM研究,共纳入约200例患者;雅培称将在10月31日至11月3日于圣地亚哥举行的TCT 2026大会上公布该研究30天随访数据。
items.summary_en: On October 28, 2026, the FDA approved Abbott's Amplatzer Paraclose PVL Occluder, making it the first and only transcatheter device cleared in the US to close paravalvular leak (PVL) around surgical aortic or mitral valve replacements, offering a minimally invasive alternative to repeat open-heart surgery. Delivered via a leg artery or vein, the device has been sold in Europe since 2020 as the Amplatzer Valvular Plug III. The approval was supported by the prospective, multicenter, single-arm PARADIGM study of roughly 200 patients; Abbott says 30-day PARADIGM outcomes will be presented at TCT 2026 in San Diego (October 31-November 3).
